howToPlay: Use the basic attack to balance between healing teammates and damaging enemies in close range. Save the Super to revive yourself or a teammate when the situation is critical. Use gadgets to double either your healing or damage output depending on the current needs of the team.
gears: Equip HEALTH and SHIELD to increase survivability while in close range. DAMAGE and SPEED are also effective options to boost offensive pressure and maneuverability.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer balancing aggressive frontline combat with supportive utility.
